# Extraction benchmark

Generated by benchmarks/bench.py. Command: `python benchmarks/bench.py`.

Timing numbers come from one machine and one run of the command above. Speed will differ on other machines. Precision and recall are copied from src/rfikit/measured.json, measured on synthetic data in a full run: family A on report seeds 101 to 130, and the written set. The timed speed input uses seeds 101 to 103 only. They are not scored again here.

- machine: arm64
- OS: macOS-27.2.1-arm64-arm-64bit-Mach-O
- CPU count: 10
- Python: 3.13.13
- rfikit commit: 7e66b6a

The commit above is the code state the numbers were run on.

Timing is the median of 5 runs after one warm-up, with the minimum and maximum, using time.perf_counter.
